scope: Official-source metadata and limited topic screening for conditional Vietnam jurisdiction; supports reviewer triage only and is not legal advice, system classification, compliance assessment, or authorization.
rules: Use the official signed text and current consolidated text; resolve each source against intended use, deployment date, provider/deployer role, product/function, and any amendments. Status is as of review_date.

sources.verified: Official registry title, issue date, effective date, signed attachment.
sources.review_question: Map AI-system role, risk classification, transparency, incident and other relevant duties after function/intended use and operating role are fixed.
sources.limits: No interpretation of application to BoneScope.

sources.verified: Official registry title and dates; signed PDF is linked. Limited text query covered Arts. 8–9 and system classification distinction.
sources.review_question: Read full Arts. 8–9, exceptions, classification notice/assessment and roles; verify whether any conditions apply to each actual system function.
sources.limits: Full provision-by-provision legal review incomplete; no BoneScope classification.

sources.instrument: Quyết định 33/2026/QĐ-TTg: high-risk AI system list
sources.verified: Official metadata and Government summary; summary identifies two surgery/robot entries in healthcare and transition date for listed systems already operating before effective date. Signed annex must be reviewed against every relevant entry and conformity column.
sources.review_question: Compare actual intended function/integration/workflow to signed list; verify entry conditions, conformity route and transition dates with Vietnamese counsel.
sources.limits: Not a complete annex interpretation; not a finding that other healthcare AI is excluded or that BoneScope is listed.

sources.instrument: Luật Bảo vệ dữ liệu cá nhân 91/2025/QH15

sources.review_question: Establish roles, purpose/legal basis, categories, notices/rights, retention, security, processor/transfer and assessment obligations for actual data flows.
sources.limits: No processing basis, patient-data authority or application determination.

sources.review_question: Use Decree 356 and current implementing forms/text; check amendments and requirements by processing role/data flow.
sources.limits: No full article-by-article assessment; Decree 13 is historical, not current at review date.

sources.review_question: Counsel to assess any relevant duties/offenses and incident-response implications.
sources.limits: Penalty instrument; not a control-design or compliance checklist.

sources.review_question: Counsel to map any creation, storage, use, sharing, cross-border, and sectoral interaction obligations; separate dataset rights from data-law obligations.

sources.limits: Future effective as at review date; no clause-level reading or application finding. Reviewer must read the signed text.

overall_conclusion: Source register improves traceability only. G7 remains OPEN; no jurisdiction is selected, no product classification/pathway/legal opinion is recorded, and no source entry should be treated as a determination.
